firstrun.title: Welcome to TM Publisher
firstrun.intro: TM Publisher keeps everything in an encrypted database on this computer. Start fresh, or bring your data from a backup file.

password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

restore.missing: Choose a backup file and type its password.

restore.explain: Restoring replaces the current data with the backup (the current database is kept aside in the data folder).
restore.master_password_note: Switch to the keyring protection first, then restore; you can set the master password again afterwards.
backup.explain: A backup contains the encrypted database only (accounts, keys, groups, posts, settings), not your media files. A forgotten backup password cannot be recovered.
